info.title: API.SH: Epic Games
info.description: The Epic Games API from API.SH: public Epic Games data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The games free to keep on the Epic Games Store this week and the ones announced for next week, with the dates the offer starts and ends, plus the other titles in the same promotion feed: id, title, slug and link, description, seller, developer, publisher, price and original price, tags, categories and images.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/epic-games-free-games

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code for prices and availability. Default US.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of texts, e.g. en-US, de, fr, ja, pt-BR. Default en-US.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A game's Epic Games Store page by its slug: title, ids, type, short and long description, developer, publisher, seller, release date, price, original price, discount and sale end date in the country, genres, features, platforms and every tag with its id, player rating (out of 5) and player poll results, audio and text languages, Windows and macOS system requirements (minimum and recommended), age ratings by country, social links and images. With `edition_offers=1`, also every offer for the game: `editions` (base game, editions, bundles), `add_ons` (DLC and in-game items) and `other_offers`, each with id, title, type, price, original price, discount, sale end date and images.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/epic-games-game

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The part after store.epicgames.com/p/ (the-witcher-3-wild-hunt, fortnite). Or give `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A store.epicgames.com game link instead of `slug`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code for prices and availability. Default US.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of texts, e.g. en-US, de, fr, ja, pt-BR. Default en-US.

parameters.name: edition_offers
parameters.description: 1 to add the game's editions, add-ons and DLC with their prices.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search or browse the Epic Games Store catalogue in a country with every store filter: keywords, category (games, editions, add-ons, demos, apps), genre and feature tags, on sale, free, price range and sort order. Each item has id, title, slug and link, type, description, seller, developer, publisher, release date, price, original price, discount, sale end date, tags, categories and images. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Also filter by platform, upcoming releases (`coming_soon`) and release-date window.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/epic-games-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words. Optional: without them the catalogue is browsed with the filters.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code for prices and availability. Default US.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of texts, e.g. en-US, de, fr, ja, pt-BR. Default en-US.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: games (base games, default), editions, addons, demos, apps or all.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag ids (all must match): 1367 RPG, 1216 action, 1117 adventure, 1210 shooter, 1264 strategy, 1083 indie, 1203 multiplayer, 1370 single player. A game's `tag_ids` in /epic-games/v1/game lists more.

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: true for discounted items only.

parameters.name: free
parameters.description: true for free items only.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum current price in the country's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum current price in the country's currency.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default with q), release_date (default without q), price, title or newest.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: asc or desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, 1-100. Default 40.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: windows or mac: only items on this platform.

parameters.name: coming_soon
parameters.description: true for items not released yet.

parameters.name: released_after
parameters.description: Only items released on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: released_before
parameters.description: Only items released on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
